title: 第17章 野猪骑士第18章 谁是奸细提前到来的猎杀
slug: 御兽开局炼妖壶吞噬就变强
lines: 鹿二发的御兽天赋为丁级治愈之光，治愈缓慢，且无法远距离施展，需要用手触碰。
娃娃脸少女孙雨棠较好一些，为丙级水雾。
施展而出，蓝色水雾如莹莹星火，包裹数只受伤的持刀狒狒，身处水雾中的狒狒们，伤势开始以肉眼可见的速度恢复…
见一切步入正轨，夜玄步入处破旧木屋。
他盘膝而坐，意识进入炼妖壶神秘空间。
此刻，壶空间积攒大团精纯灵气，如天上厚实白云。
这些，都是由近期猎杀到的妖尸炼化得到。
先升前者，前者在带动后者。
受到兽契限制，夜狩境界卡在一阶十星，迟迟无法突破二阶境界，此时，也该轮到自己提升。
兽尸越多，能炼化得到的灵气，也就越多。
夜玄信心十足，有把握在十天特训结束后，将自身的御兽师境界，强行提升到二阶境！
境界方面提升，不仅可以加强御兽师体质、灵魂。
二阶御兽师，更是能额外凝聚出一枚兽契。
用于契约第二只妖宠！
深呼一口气，夜玄闭上黑眸，吸收起壶内灵气。
受到牵引。
壶内灵气纷纷逸散而出，涌入夜玄口鼻…
时间流逝。
帐篷内，夜玄的境界如雨后春笋噌噌暴涨。
一阶二星…
一阶三星…
一阶四星…
一阶五星…
当夜幕彻底降临时，少年默默睁开明亮双眸。
炼妖壶内炼化得到的灵力彻底清空，半个时辰，一阶六星。
恐怖的提升！
要知御兽师境界提升向来艰难，平民御兽师从一阶突破至二阶，至少也需耗费一年光阴。
当然，这里说的是平民。
拥有家族底蕴的御兽师提升速度只会更快。
毕竟人家不缺资源。
夜玄扭了扭脖颈，感受起一阶一星与一阶六星不同之处。
身体素质增强约莫一倍有余，五感方面也都得到提升，御兽空间范围，同样如此。
“可以。”
“身体素质变强，至少不会沦为脆皮炮灰。”
夜玄嘴角扯起笑意，起身推开残破木门出屋。
外界繁星点点，鹿二发与孙雨棠面露疲惫，正坐在树下啃食野果。
伤势恢复的老狒王大壮咆哮低吼，抖了抖一身厚重皮毛，肩扛骇人骨刀走向夜玄。

Lu Erfa's beast-controlling talent is D-level healing light. It heals slowly and cannot be used from a long distance. It needs to be touched by hand.
The baby-faced girl Sun Yutang is better, a level C water mist.
After it was released, the blue water mist was like sparkling sparks, wrapping up several injured knife-wielding baboons. The injuries of the baboons in the water mist began to recover at a speed visible to the naked eye...
Seeing that everything was on track, Ye Xuan walked into a dilapidated wooden house.
He sat cross-legged and his consciousness entered the mysterious space of the Demon Refining Pot.
At this moment, a large mass of pure spiritual energy accumulated in the pot space, like thick white clouds in the sky.
These are all refined from the demon corpses that were hunted recently.
The former is promoted first, and the former is driving the latter.
Restricted by the beast contract, the Night Hunting Realm is stuck at the first level and ten stars, and has been unable to break through to the second level. At this time, it is also his turn to improve.
The more beast corpses there are, the more spiritual energy can be refined.
Ye Xuan is full of confidence and is sure that after the ten days of special training, he will forcibly upgrade his level of beast master to the second level!
Improving the realm can not only strengthen the physique and soul of the beast master.
A second-level beast master can even condense an additional beast bond.
Used to contract the second demon pet!
Taking a deep breath, Ye Xuan closed his black eyes and absorbed the spiritual energy in the pot.
Being pulled.
The spiritual energy in the pot escaped one after another and poured into Ye Xuan's mouth and nose...
Time passes.
In the tent, Ye Xuan's realm mushroomed like bamboo shoots after a rain.
First level two stars…
First level three stars…
First level four stars…
First level five stars…
When night fell completely, the young man silently opened his bright eyes.
The spiritual power obtained by refining the demon in the demon refining pot was completely emptied, and in half an hour, the first level was six stars.
Terrifying improvement!
You must know that it is always difficult to improve the realm of a beast master. It takes at least a year for a civilian beast master to break through from the first level to the second level.
Of course, I'm talking about civilians here.
Beast masters with family heritage will only improve faster.
After all, there is no shortage of resources.
Ye Xuan twisted his neck and felt the difference between the first-order one-star and the first-order six-star.
The physical fitness has been more than doubled, the five senses have also been improved, and the same is true for the space range of beast control.
"Okay."
"If you become physically stronger, at least you won't be reduced to a fragile cannon fodder."
Ye Xuan smiled, stood up, pushed open the broken wooden door and left the house.
There were stars in the outside world. Lu Erfa and Sun Yutang looked tired and were sitting under the tree eating wild fruits.
"Roar!"
The old baboon king, Da Zhuang, who had recovered from his injury, roared, shook his thick fur, and walked toward Ye Xuan with a terrifying bone knife on his shoulder.
